## Findings (read-only; no files changed)

### What the law lattice is

`dashboard/static/lattices/law_lattice.json` is a static **rule-lattice export** (`"schema": "lattice_logic.v1"`, `"family": "rule lattice"`, `"source": "queue/lanes/law_lattice.json"`). Each entry carries `id`, `name`, `statement`, `source` (usually a `watch/*_20260904.md` receipt), `scope`, `enforcement` (runtime / structural / prose), `consumer` (the organ that must honor it), and `disposition` (FOLDED / ROUTED / SHELVED). Its own LAW-003 (lines 29–37) declares that every file under `dashboard/static/lattices/` must be produced **only** by `mag.lattice_logic` export with that shape — raw copies forbidden (a `cp` once collapsed 47 entries into 1). So the dashboard directory is a **read mirror**; the authoritative sources are `queue/lanes/law_lattice.json`, `memory/law/registry.json`, and `memory/percolator/invariants.json`.

The companion `dashboard/static/lattices/law_registry.json` is a **different law family**: bare IDs `LAW-1…LAW-10` (8 present: 1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10), tier `T0`, shaped as `trigger/condition/action/guardrail` — runtime-enforceable governance laws (rails_over_direction, swarm_self_heals, Ostrom principles, cofinish_qstar_split), registered Aug 10–25.

`dashboard/static/lattices/invariants.json` is a **behavioral frequency registry** (`"family": "registry"`, `"source": "memory/percolator/invariants.json"`): 47 `_key` rows of recurring failure/steer strings with `first_seen`/`last_seen` counts (e.g. "Trust bytes, not reports", "backend reported failure").

### Counts

| Artifact | Path | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Rule lattice | `dashboard/static/lattices/law_lattice.json` (header `"count": 58`; grep confirms 58 `"id": "LAW-"`) | **58 laws, LAW-001–LAW-058** |
| Runtime registry (mirror) | `dashboard/static/lattices/law_registry.json` | **8 laws** (LAW-1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10) |
| Invariants (mirror) | `dashboard/static/lattices/invariants.json` (header `"count": 47`) | **47 invariants** |

Lattice dispositions: 53 FOLDED, 4 ROUTED (LAW-046, 048 candidates), 1 SHELVED (LAW-047). Enforcement: 25 runtime, 8 structural, 25 prose.

Newest `last_seen` in the invariants mirror: `2026-09-04T14:01:12Z`. Newest registry `last_enforced_ts` in the mirror: `2026-09-04T12:27:13Z`.

- `memory/percolator/invariants.json` mtime **2026-09-22 17:32**, live `last_seen` up to `2026-09-22T14:55:19Z` (141 date hits Sep 12–22) — the dashboard mirror's data stopped 18 days ago.
- `queue/lanes/law_lattice.json` itself is also frozen at 2026-09-04 17:40 — the rule lattice as a whole has not grown since.
